verified_passes.evidence: Fresh local runs reproduced 24/24, 106/106 and 15/15 with zero reported failures.
The facade rejects a fully encoded request above 1500000 bytes, and the worker independently reads at most 1500001 bytes.

blockers.cause: The facade bounds request characters, individual frame strings, depth and value-node count, but carries no cumulative canonical JSON/UTF-8 byte count. It snapshots the whole frame, then materializes json.dumps(envelope) and its UTF-8 bytes, and only afterward checks len(request_bytes). Object keys are not included in any string-size or cumulative-byte bound.

bounded_probe.frame_shape: eight exact string values of 200000 ASCII characters each
bounded_probe.observed_exception: ValueError: request exceeds worker protocol byte bound

blockers.impact: The nominal 1500000-byte protocol limit is not an allocation bound. An aggregate frame whose members each satisfy the local checks can allocate the complete JSON string and encoded byte string before rejection, so memory pressure or MemoryError can precede the intended bounded failure.

coverage_gap: The 24-group self-test checks per-value snapshot failures but has no over-budget aggregate frame, oversized-key case, exact-boundary case, or assertion that serialization is not entered after the cumulative budget is exhausted. The inherited 106/106 and 15/15 replays do not exercise the facade memory boundary.
minimal_fix: During the exact snapshot traversal, maintain an exact cumulative count for the canonical request envelope before calling json.dumps.

Count JSON syntax, fixed envelope keys and version, original_request, every object key, every scalar and all JSON escaping using strict UTF-8 byte lengths under ensure_ascii=false and separators=(',', ':').
Abort immediately when the count exceeds 1500000 bytes; string length in Python characters is not a substitute for JSON/UTF-8 byte length.
After the pre-count succeeds, serialize once and retain len(request_bytes) == counted_bytes <= 1500000 as a postcondition.
required_regressions: An aggregate of individually valid strings and an oversized object key must be rejected before json.dumps is called.
Exercise ASCII, multibyte Unicode, JSON escapes and lone-surrogate rejection.
Exercise exactly 1500000 bytes and 1500001 bytes and compare the pre-count with the actual canonical encoding length.
next_step: Prepare an offline successor with the cumulative pre-serialization JSON/UTF-8 budget and repeat independent review. Do not create or authorize a freeze, gate, network call, model call or live run from V26.5.4.
